desc: Tenacious, Persistence, Resilience and Ambitious are qualities we aspire to when facing challenges. These traits are revered at Spyderco and why we named our line of Value Folders after them. Folders with five-star features: G-10 handles, Walker LinerLocks, jimping, lined lanyard holes and skeletonized full-length internal liners. The Ambitious is a small, palm-sized workhorse offering big performance in a compact package.
